correctness.rationale: Normalized Laplacian eigenvalues 1-cos(theta) and even-site downsampling give exactly (1/sqrt(2))[[1,1],[e^-t(1-u),e^-t(1+u)]]. Its Gram trace 1+e^-2t+2d, determinant d=e^-2t sinh^2(tu), eigenvalues increase in u. Hence A=Lambda_-(c,t), B=Lambda_+(1,t) are sharp for 0<c<1. At c=0 alias collision prevents any finite-time positive frame lower bound. Uniform c^-2 A_c(t)<=t^2 exp(-t) yields sharp small-gap max and argmax t0 solving t0=1+e^-2t0. Independently checked matrix eigenvalue endpoints at three c,t pairs.
